lead_raw_text:
This MgTi structure crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1 (No. 1), with a unit cell containing two atoms—one Mg and one Ti—distributed across two independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows both Mg and Ti centers adopt 12-neighbor, close-packed-like local arrangements: Mg is surrounded by 4 Mg and 8 Ti neighbors, while Ti has 8 Mg and 4 Ti neighbors, with neighbor distances ranging from about 2.84 to 3.16 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning both sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations reveal corner- and face-sharing between Mg and Ti 12-vertex coordination polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing among Mg-centered polyhedra.
